title: Clacking Cuttlefish
statement: Dwelling in a twilight grotto of frosted sea glass and swaying fern-kelp, this curious cephalopod spends its days meticulously sorting colorful pebbles into intricate, ever-changing mosaics with a soft, rhythmic clack. Whenever it solves a pattern to its liking, constellations of warm bioluminescent ripples dance across its skin like sudden sparks of thought.
